prompt.sdd.effects.classify:
Classify ONE pending action from the {ceremony} into an objective check, which the app will run later with GET requests to {vcsName} only. Do not use tools.
Action: «{text}»
Activity: {ref} (repository mentioned: {repo}). The issue {issue} lives in the project {project}.
MRs of the activity (project and iid to use): {mrs}. Stage: {stage}.
Available check types:
{kinds}
Rules: pick a type only if the state of {vcsName} proves the action was done. If it is vague, personal, local (git, worktree, spec), a work item status change (not a label) or needs judgment, answer type "nenhum" and verificavel false.
When the MR mentioned is not in the MR list above, use "nenhum". "projeto" is the project path (group/repo), "iid" the number of the MR or of the issue (null for the types that create things), "valor" the type parameter or null, "motivo" one short sentence.

main.radar.recommendation.same-fix: Read both pieces before merging and comment on both MRs the same day: it is the only finding with a deadline, because after the merge whoever lost goes back to QA for free. If it is the same fix, keep just one.
main.radar.recommendation.dependency: Sequence them: the activity further behind goes in after. Do not branch from its branch or duplicate the code it brings.
main.radar.recommendation.file: Agree on who touches what before both move on. After the first merge, update the other with main and check again.
main.radar.recommendation.scope: Just align the scope and check whether both depend on the same decision (same config, same business rule). It blocks nothing.
